You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From e8b9681a22d16464fb5920eed916d9375de44b21 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: kb634 <kb634@york.ac.uk>
Date: Thu, 25 Jul 2019 16:27:33 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] fixes error introduced in commit d76b709

---
 .../src/org/eclipse/scava/crossflow/web/CrossflowHandler.java   | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/crossflow/org.eclipse.scava.crossflow.web/src/org/eclipse/scava/crossflow/web/CrossflowHandler.java b/crossflow/org.eclipse.scava.crossflow.web/src/org/eclipse/scava/crossflow/web/CrossflowHandler.java
index 61f1c8378..0647c89a8 100755
--- a/crossflow/org.eclipse.scava.crossflow.web/src/org/eclipse/scava/crossflow/web/CrossflowHandler.java
+++ b/crossflow/org.eclipse.scava.crossflow.web/src/org/eclipse/scava/crossflow/web/CrossflowHandler.java
@@ -63,7 +63,7 @@ public class CrossflowHandler implements Crossflow.Iface {
 
 			Workflow workflow = (Workflow) classLoader.loadClass(experiment.getClassName())
 					.getConstructor(Mode.class).newInstance(mode);
-
+			workflow.getSerializer().setClassloader(classLoader);
 			workflow.setInstanceId(experimentId);
 			workflow.createBroker(false);
 			File cacheDir = new File(servlet.getServletContext().getRealPath("experiments/" + experimentId + "/cache"));
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was introduced in commit d76b709 due to the missing call to `workflow.getSerializer().setClassloader(classLoader);`, which is necessary for setting the classloader for the serializer used in the workflow. Without this call, the serializer may not function properly, leading to errors when trying to serialize or deserialize objects within the workflow, thereby disrupting the expected workflow execution. The patch implemented a fix by reintroducing this line of code.

Root cause:
The bug was introduced in commit d76b709 due to the missing call to `workflow.getSerializer().setClassloader(classLoader);`, which is necessary for setting the classloader for the serializer used in the workflow. Without this call, the serializer may not function properly, leading to errors when trying to serialize or deserialize objects within the workflow, thereby disrupting the expected workflow execution. The patch implemented a fix by reintroducing this line of code.
